SqlAuthenticationInitializer.summary: Initializes authentication providers configured in app.config.
SqlAuthenticationInitializer.remarks: Configured initializers run synchronously during registry bootstrap while the registry lock is held. Calls to and on the current thread are supported. Do not synchronously wait for another thread that calls either method: that thread blocks on the registry lock, causing a deadlock. Exceptions from initialization or registration abort registry bootstrap. Earlier registrations and initializer side effects are not rolled back.

Initialize.remarks: When invoked by registry bootstrap, this method executes while the registry lock is held. Calls to and on the current thread are supported. Do not synchronously wait for another thread that calls either method. The other thread blocks on the registry lock, causing a deadlock.
